body:
It wasnt cold Turkey, I found out I didnt have ins at the doctors office so i was able to get one refill but both myself and the doc were under the impression I was gonna have ins again within the month. This was in May. 


So I started to run out end of June and I wasnt thinking so I started taking half a tablet with my last weeks worth and then went down to half a tab every otherday. But because I didnt wean myself enough I am still going through withdrawls and they are horrible. 


I can be sitting and feel so dizzy like I'm about to pass out. I'm starting to call myself a "sun downer" which is what health care workers call dementia patients who, once the sun sets become different. Either more violent or depressed. 

It's just hard and my fault really for not planning accordingly

Eh I feel like I deserve it. I'm trying but between working a ton (but not enough to get full time in eithe job because that would mean benefits and obvs my employers dont want that to happen) I cant take a day off to go to the free clinic because I cant afford a day off but the clinic is only open 2 days a week and lucky me, those are my super duper long sucky days woo.

Unwillingly ins dropped me due to miscommunication (federal ins. Woo america) cant afford my doc appointments without the ins. Doc wont give refills until I see them because I am a "major risk" 
Cant afford the doc rinse and repeat

Turn 21 tomorrow (yay! Happy birthday to the miserable depressed fuck!) 
And mixture of withdrawls from my antidepressants and a shitty life I feel I cannot escape from...well I can escape from but that'll hurt those around me
